query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

messages.content: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

message.content:
You can buy the **latest iPhone** directly from the **Apple Store online or in an Apple Store**; Apple says it’s the best place to buy and notes that iPhones bought there are generally **unlocked**.[1][3]

Other major retailers and carriers that currently sell the newest iPhone models include **AT&T**, **Verizon**, **Target**, **Best Buy**, **Walmart**, and **Metro by T-Mobile**.[4][5][6][7][8][2]

If you want the simplest option, start with **Apple**. If you want a carrier deal, check **AT&T** or **Verizon** first.[1][4][6]
